subject: Requesting verification of APAC edge egress spike and SLA entitlement; postmortem invite
messages:
From: Samir Patel <ops@signalworks.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T03:47:00Z
Subject: Spike of 504/egress errors from APAC (Jul 28 23:10-23:55 UTC)

Hi Mina,

We observed a sustained spike of 504 and downstream egress errors for several of our checkout endpoints last night. Our telemetry shows the window roughly between 2028-07-28 23:10 UTC and 2028-07-28 23:55 UTC. Impact: ~15-22% of requests returning 504 / connection aborts depending on region (APAC only).

Attached: client_errors.log (small excerpt).

Two quick asks: can Redwood confirm whether there was any infrastructure egress failure on your APAC edge during that window, and whether this would meet the threshold for an SLA credit per our contract? We need confirmation to start internal remediation and notify product owners.

Happy to jump on a call if helpful — Samir (ops@signalworks.com)

--
Samir Patel
Head of Site Reliability, SignalWorks
ops@signalworks.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <ops@signalworks.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T04:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike of 504/egress errors from APAC (Jul 28 23:10-23:55 UTC)

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and the log excerpt. I've looped in our SRE (Diego) and your account lead (Laura).

Immediate plan:
- Diego: can you validate whether any egress/edge flaps or upstream peering issues correlate to the window Samir called out? Please include the exact start/end timestamps and a short rationale for SLA classification (full outage vs partial availability).
- Samir: could you share a 1-minute-sampled trace or the traffic split by node (if available)? That will help us determine whether this was a regional routing issue vs backend degradation.

We will treat this as a potential SLA claim until telemetry proves otherwise. If it qualifies, we will draft a provisional credit calculation and invite SignalWorks to a postmortem meeting (internal + customer-facing).

Attachments: none on my reply.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Customer Reliability Manager 
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:30:00Z
Subject: Preliminary telemetry: APAC egress packet loss; candidate window 23:15-23:48 UTC

Mina / Laura — quick pre-PR update based on early telemetry pull.

Summary (prelim):
- Observed elevated TCP retransmits and SYN timeouts from our APAC egress routers between 2028-07-28T23:15:00Z and 2028-07-28T23:48:00Z.
- Error surface: increased 504s and downstream connection aborts on the egress plane.
- Scope: traffic to APAC customers showed ~18% of requests experiencing degraded responses in that window; global traffic unaffected.

Root-candidate: We have evidence of an eBGP flap at one of our edge egress peers in ap-southeast which caused transient path asymmetry and packet loss. Peering partner has been notified for their logs.

SLA implication (initial thought):
- Per contract (section 4.2), partial regional availability impacts are measured by percent of successful requests across the tenant's traffic. If SignalWorks saw ~18% of requests affected, that would typically meet the partial-availability threshold used for prorated credits.

Attachments: prelim_traces.txt (extracted trace IDs and sample tcpdump lines)
Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8421

Next steps I propose:
1) Pull per-node request counts from SignalWorks' tenant for the window (Samir — if you can provide the sampling it helps us align numbers).
2) Confirm peering partner logs (we already requested).
3) If numbers align, draft a provisional credit calc and invite SignalWorks to a postmortem (we should include a tech + ops owner and an account lead).

Diego Fernandez
SRE Lead — Networking
Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <ops@signalworks.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T14:12:00Z
Subject: Customer-facing next steps: SLA entitlement, provisional credit and postmortem invite

Hi Samir — thanks again for raising this and to Diego for the quick analysis.

We're ready to move forward with a customer-facing path: below is what we propose and what we need from SignalWorks to finalize entitlement and credit calculation.

What Redwood will do:
- Produce a consolidated timeline and packet-level evidence (our attachment: prelim_traces.txt).
- Calculate a provisional credit using the percentage-of-affected-requests approach in section 4.2 of the SLSA (we've included a draft calculation in sla_calc_apac.csv). Based on current telemetry the draft credit is 0.18 * monthly recurring fee pro-rated for the elapsed window (example attached).
- Host a 60-minute postmortem on Aug 1, 2028 at 16:00 SGT (invite attached as postmortem_invite.ics). The meeting will include ops, SRE, and account teams; we'll share a short RCA doc ahead of time.

What we need from SignalWorks:
- Per-node/request sampling or a high-level count of total requests during the candidate window (this is used to align percentages).
- Any client-side traces showing connection resets or failed TLS handshakes during 23:10–23:55 UTC.

Quoted for context:
> On 2028-07-29T09:30:00Z Diego Fernandez wrote:
> 
> Observed elevated TCP retransmits and SYN timeouts from our APAC egress routers between 2028-07-28T23:15:00Z and 2028-07-28T23:48:00Z.
> Scope: traffic to APAC customers showed ~18% of requests experiencing degraded responses in that window; global traffic unaffected.

Samir — if that timeline aligns with your internal data, please reply with the request counts and confirm whether Aug 1 16:00 SGT works for a postmortem. Once we align numbers we'll circulate a short customer-facing RCA and the provisional credit calculation for your review.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
